name: w12-google-flights
intent: Read-only research task, in a fresh browser visit (do not answer from earlier messages), using the browser rather than the flight-search tool: on Google Flights, find the cheapest nonstop round trip ATL to MCO leaving next Friday and returning Sunday.
hard_part: Airport comboboxes, date picker, dynamic results

key_nodes.description: ATL to MCO search with dates

final_state.description: Results filtered to nonstop with prices

answer_check.description: Airline, departure times and a $ price, nonstop

live_stops_before: any sign-in, account creation, add-to-cart, reservation, booking, subscription, consent, CAPTCHA or bot check, and every final/commit/protected button
grading: A lane-specific Pass needs that run's own evidence: the research task result (answer, page URL, browser session) on the lane being scored. A cloud fallback never counts for the home column.
